subject: DR tabletop: keystore rotation & RTO/RPO evidence
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@finsecure.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: compliance@finsecure.com
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: DR tabletop: keystore rotation & RTO/RPO evidence

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/BCP review we'd like to validate two things ahead of the July renewal:

1) A short, self-contained artifact set that demonstrates keystore rotation and key availability during a restore (logs + timeline).
2) A representative RTO/RPO sampling report for the last 90 days, including the methodology used to measure RTO (what you measure from/to) and the environment used (warm cache, cold restore, region).

Can Redwood provide an artifacts package and a one-hour tabletop walkthrough for our security team? We're aiming for the week of July 6 — ideally a session with ops + your SRE.

Specific asks:
- Keystore rotation logs with timestamps and operator IDs (redact keys).
- One sample restore trace that includes: start time, KV rehydration, service readiness health checks, and time-to-first-successful-query.
- RTO/RPO sampling CSV and a short explanation of sampling windows.
- Ops runbook excerpt that lists the run-level steps for emergency restore.

Attachments: SIG-BCP-Appendix.pdf (we attached our questionnaire that references the above).

If possible, please share a tentative list of artifacts and a proposed date/time.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Security & Risk | FinSecure

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@finsecure.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DR tabletop: keystore rotation & RTO/RPO evidence

Hi Elena — appreciate the clear asks. We'll assemble the artifacts and are happy to run the tabletop. High-level next steps from our side:

1) I'm assigning Marissa (SRE lead) to produce the keystore rotation trace and ops-runbook excerpt; Ben will export the RTO/RPO sampling CSV and a short methodology note.
2) We'll redact any sensitive secret material (we'll provide checksums and rotation metadata rather than keys).
3) Proposed workshop: July 7, 10:00–11:00 PT (we can move if needed).

Planned deliverables (pre-call):
- rto_rpo_snapshot.csv (sampling: rolling 90d, one-minute granularity where available).
- keystore_rotation_log.txt (timestamps, operator IDs, rotation job ids).
- ops-runbook.pdf (excerpt with restore checklist).
- tabletop-invite.ics (calendar stub).

If that works for you we will upload everything to a shared drive and send a DocuSign attestation for the artifacts package (we've done this for other financial customers).

I'll follow up after Marissa and Ben confirm the timeline.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Customer Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

(Attachment stubs: will attach rto_rpo_snapshot.csv, keystore_rotation_log.txt, ops-runbook.pdf prior to call)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Cc: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@finsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DR tabletop: keystore rotation & RTO/RPO evidence

On Sat, Jun 27, 2026 at 10:03 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com> wrote:
> Planned deliverables (pre-call):
> - rto_rpo_snapshot.csv
> - keystore_rotation_log.txt
> - ops-runbook.pdf

Elena / Aditya — putting a note here with our approach and what I'll attach by EOD Jul 2: 

Summary of approach:
- Keystore rotation: we will provide the rotation job run (job id ROTO-20260611-42), event timestamps (rotate_start, new_key_published, services_notified, rotation_complete), and operator id (system id only; human operator redacted). The log will not include any secret material.
- Restore trace: we will export one warm-start restore trace (region: us-west-2) showing KV cache rehydration timeline. For RTO measurement we measure from restore-init (operator triggers restore job) to first successful end-to-end inference request (confirmed via tracing id).
- RTO/RPO sampling: CSV will include sample_time, measured_rto_seconds, measured_rpo_seconds, environment (warm|cold), region, and a trace_id for verification when available. We sample 30 restore events across the last 90 days (tabletop will include a short note on selection bias).

Exhibit files I will attach: 
- rto_rpo_snapshot.csv (30 samples, summary row with median/95th percentiles)
- keystore_rotation_log.txt (rotation job metadata)
- ops-runbook.pdf (excerpt, page 3–5 containing emergency restore checklist)
- tabletop-invite.ics (calendar item)

Runbook excerpt (snippet):
"Step 3: Initiate restore job (restore-manager --env prod --start)
Step 4: Wait for KV rehydration; confirm via /health/kv endpoint returning status=ready
Step 5: Kick smoke test traffic (smoke-client --trace) and validate first-successful-query metric."

Notes/risks:
- Cold restores (full rebuilds) are less frequently sampled; our representative set skews toward warm restores since those are the ones exercised during on-call drills. If FinSecure needs additional cold-restore samples we can schedule a controlled exercise.

I'll upload the artifacts to the shared link Aditya will send.

Marissa Cole
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
(Attachment stubs included in upload)

From: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@finsecure.com>

Couple quick items:
- Can we shift the tabletop to July 9 at 11:00 PT instead of July 7? That's better for our reviewers.
- Please include a short attestation (DocuSign) that the artifacts are complete and unaltered since export; we prefer a signed package before our internal review.

If you can send the shared link and the attestation request, I'll route to our SOC owner and confirm the final attendees.

Best,
Elena

FinSecure | Risk & Compliance
